test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five persons K, L, P, N and O are sitting in a straight line, all facing in the same direction. L is second to the right of N. K is third to the right of P. O is sitting adjacent to K. Who is sitting to the immediate left of P?
solution:
Five person:- K, L, P, N and O

1) All are facing same direction. L is second to the right of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b890ef7f35533af90312eec5642e8b3d5cb30af3ef3a7de6504e321d1340c559.png] 

2) K is third to the right of P. O is sitting adjacent to K.

(Case 2 is eliminate because according to case 2 there is no place for **P **who sit third right of **K)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1204fb30e8214ff8d6065d3f0eab9bc69e05a40e1dfbd75883d1ced2fc7dcef6.png] 

(Case:3 is also eliminate because according to case 3 **O **is not sitting adjacent to **K)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c22114e9dc50ac77fd63d361d567805fe7f9b290a1be8b05889cf9f10539b36.png] 

Clearly, we can see that **N **is sitting immediate left of **P.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"N".**
